# Purpose

SS3 is not run here. A finished SS3 folder supplies length compositions through `sstruth::ssLen()`. FLicc is fitted to those lengths with life history taken from the same SS3 run. The product is selectivity, current $F$, and spawning potential (SPR). The Kobe lines stay blank.

Guide: [FLicc user guide](https://henning-winker.github.io/FLicc/FLicc_user_guide.html).

This file is the worked example (IOTC blue shark, fleet `F3_OTHER_LL`, females). For another stock, change only the marked block. The steps after that stay the same.

# 1. Inputs

```{r inputs}
# --- stock and paths ---
stock_id <- "bsh-io"
ss3_dir  <- "P:/zbook/datasets/ss3/bsh-io"
# Prefer the cached extract when present (no SS3 read needed):
cache    <- file.path("..", "data", "bsh-io", "flicc_inputs.RData")
# cache  <- file.path("data", "bsh-io", "flicc_inputs.RData")

# --- which composition ---
fleet    <- 3L          # F3_OTHER_LL; see FleetNames in the SS3 folder
sex      <- 1L          # 1 = female (maturity / SPR)
ess      <- 500         # rescale each year to this effective sample size
n_years  <- 10          # terminal years used in the fit

# --- selectivity ---
sel_fun  <- "logistic"  # longline: asymptotic; use "dsnormal" for dome

# --- rebuild from SS3 even if cache exists? ---
rebuild  <- FALSE
```

# 2. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
need <- c("FLCore", "FLicc")
for (p in need) {
  if (!requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Install ", p, ". FLicc: remotes::install_local('C:/work/flr/02_others/FLicc')")
  }
}
library(FLCore)
library(FLicc)

cache_candidates <- c(
  cache,
  file.path("data", "bsh-io", "flicc_inputs.RData"),
  file.path("..", "data", "bsh-io", "flicc_inputs.RData")
)
cache_path <- cache_candidates[file.exists(cache_candidates)][1]
```

# 3. Length comps from SS3 (`sstruth::ssLen`)

`ssLen(ss3_dir)` returns `db` (`lendbase`), plus fit, controls and summary tables. Observed proportions in `db$Obs` are turned into counts, rescaled to `ess` per year (FLicc’s Dirichlet–multinomial default wants raw counts or ESS around 500+), trimmed above $L_{\infty}$, and passed through `lfd_long_to_wide()` → `FLQuantLen()`.

SS3 `Bin` values for this stock are bin mid-points (20, 25, … cm), so `midL = TRUE`.

```{r extract, message=FALSE}
have_cache <- !is.na(cache_path) && !isTRUE(rebuild)

if (have_cache) {
  load(cache_path)
  # objects: lfd_df, lh_df, meta, spr (cached), fcur (cached), ss3_b, ss3_f
} else {
  if (!requireNamespace("sstruth", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("r4ss", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Need sstruth and r4ss to rebuild from SS3, or point cache at flicc_inputs.RData.")
  }
  library(sstruth)
  library(r4ss)

  ss3_candidates <- c(
    ss3_dir,
    file.path("P:", "zbook", "datasets", "ss3", stock_id),
    file.path("..", "data", stock_id)
  )
  ss3_dir <- ss3_candidates[file.exists(file.path(ss3_candidates, "Report.sso"))][1]
  if (is.na(ss3_dir)) stop("Report.sso not found. Set ss3_dir.")

  lns <- ssLen(ss3_dir)
  rep <- SS_output(
    ss3_dir, forecast = FALSE, covar = FALSE, verbose = FALSE,
    printstats = FALSE, hidewarn = TRUE, NoCompOK = TRUE
  )
  fn <- setNames(rep$FleetNames, seq_along(rep$FleetNames))
  gp <- rep$Growth_Parameters[rep$Growth_Parameters$Sex == sex, ][1, ]
  linf <- as.numeric(gp$Linf)

  db <- lns$db
  db <- db[db$Fleet == fleet & db$Sex == sex & db$Bin < linf, ]
  if (!nrow(db)) stop("No length rows for that fleet/sex.")
  db$qname <- as.character(fn[as.character(db$Fleet)])
  db$prop <- pmax(0, db$Obs)
  db$prop[!is.finite(db$prop)] <- 0

  lfd_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(db, db$Yr), function(d) {
    s <- sum(d$prop)
    if (!is.finite(s) || s <= 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      len = d$Bin,
      year = d$Yr[1],
      data = ess * d$prop / s,
      qname = d$qname[1],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  rownames(lfd_df) <- NULL

  lh_df <- data.frame(
    param = c("linf", "k", "M", "L50", "a", "b"),
    value = c(
      linf,
      as.numeric(gp$K),
      mean(c(as.numeric(gp$M_age0), as.numeric(gp$M_nages))),
      as.numeric(gp$Mat1),
      as.numeric(gp$WtLen1),
      as.numeric(gp$WtLen2)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  meta <- list(
    fleet = fleet,
    fleet_name = unique(lfd_df$qname),
    sex = sex,
    ess = ess,
    ss3_dir = ss3_dir,
    midL = TRUE
  )
  ss3_b <- ss3_f <- NA_real_
  smry_path <- file.path(dirname(ss3_dir), "smry.RData")
  local_smry <- c(
    file.path("data", stock_id, "smry.RData"),
    file.path("..", "data", stock_id, "smry.RData")
  )
  smry_path <- c(file.path(ss3_dir, "smry.RData"), local_smry)
  smry_path <- smry_path[file.exists(smry_path)][1]
  if (!is.na(smry_path)) {
    e <- new.env()
    load(smry_path, envir = e)
    kb <- e$smry$kb
    ss3_b <- kb$stock[nrow(kb)]
    ss3_f <- kb$harvest[nrow(kb)]
  }
}

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Source", "Fleet", "Sex", "Years", "ESS per year",
      "Length bins (mid, cm)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      if (have_cache) cache_path else meta$ss3_dir,
      paste0(meta$fleet, " (", meta$fleet_name, ")"),
      meta$sex,
      paste(range(lfd_df$year), collapse = "–"),
      meta$ess,
      paste(range(lfd_df$len), collapse = "–")
    )
  ),
  col.names = c("Item", "Value")
)
```

# 4. Life history from SS3

Female growth, $M$ (mean of age-0 and plus-group), maturity and weight–length from the SS3 `Growth_Parameters` table. FLicc holds these fixed.

```{r life-history}
lhpar <- FLPar(
  linf = lh_df$value[lh_df$param == "linf"],
  k    = lh_df$value[lh_df$param == "k"],
  M    = lh_df$value[lh_df$param == "M"],
  L50  = lh_df$value[lh_df$param == "L50"],
  a    = lh_df$value[lh_df$param == "a"],
  b    = lh_df$value[lh_df$param == "b"]
)
knitr::kable(lh_df, digits = 5)
```

# 5. Build `FLQuants` and `FLStockLen`

```{r lfd, fig.width=8, fig.height=5, message=FALSE}
lfd <- FLQuantLen(lfd_long_to_wide(lfd_df), unit = "cm", midL = isTRUE(meta$midL))
stklen <- stocklen(lfd, lhpar, m_model = "constant")

plot_lfd(lfd, type = "relmax")
```

Check one main mode, no sudden year-to-year jumps, and almost no fish beyond $L_{\infty}$.

# 6. Fit FLicc

```{r fit, message=FALSE}
yrs <- as.numeric(dimnames(lfd[[1]])$year)
years_fit <- if (!is.null(meta$years_fit) && have_cache && !isTRUE(rebuild)) {
  meta$years_fit
} else {
  yrs[yrs >= max(yrs) - (n_years - 1)]
}

fit <- fiticc(
  lfd, stklen,
  sel_fun = sel_fun,
  catch_by_gear = 1,
  years = years_fit,
  settings = list(
    CVL = 0.1,
    obs_model = "dm",
    dm_theta = "saturating",
    maxsd = 3
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)

flicc_convergence(fit)
```

All rows should show `passed = TRUE`. Overall `ok` is required before reading SPR.

# 7. Results

```{r results, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5, message=FALSE}
plot_len(fit)
plot_sel(fit)
plot_spr(fit, ci = TRUE)

spr_hat <- as.numeric(sprcur_flicc(fit))
f_hat   <- as.numeric(fcur_flicc(fit))

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Years fitted", "SPR (terminal)", "F (terminal)",
      "SS3 B/Bmsy (terminal)", "SS3 F/Fmsy (terminal)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      paste(range(years_fit), collapse = "–"),
      sprintf("%.3f", spr_hat),
      sprintf("%.3f", f_hat),
      if (is.na(ss3_b)) "—" else sprintf("%.2f", ss3_b),
      if (is.na(ss3_f)) "—" else sprintf("%.2f", ss3_f)
    )
  ),
  col.names = c("Item", "Value")
)
```

SPR near 0.4 is a common target. A Kobe point is **not** written from this fit. The SS3 $B/B_{\mathrm{MSY}}$ and $F/F_{\mathrm{MSY}}$ rows are External context only.

# 8. Three-strand checklist (this fit)

| Strand | What you just did | Red flag |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Internal | `flicc_convergence()`, `plot_len()`, `plot_sel()` | Failed convergence; residuals piled in the tail; dome forced on a longline |
| External | Life history and lengths from the same SS3 OM; SS3 status in the table | $L_{\infty}$ below the largest fish kept; SPR contradicts every other signal without a reason |
| Robustness | Change `sel_fun`, `ess`, or `n_years` and re-knit | Advice sentence flips when selectivity or ESS changes |

# 9. Your stock

Copy this file. Change only what follows.

1. **`stock_id` / `ss3_dir`** — folder with `Report.sso`, or a new `flicc_inputs.RData` built the same way.  
2. **`fleet` / `sex`** — from `SS_output(...)$FleetNames` and the sex code in `lendbase`.  
3. **`sel_fun`** — `"logistic"` for asymptotic gears; `"dsnormal"` when a dome is expected.  
4. **`ess` / `n_years`** — keep ESS ≥ 500 unless you have a reason.  
5. **`rebuild <- TRUE`** — re-extract with `sstruth::ssLen()` instead of the cache.

Then knit again. The objects to recognise are `lfd`, `stklen`, `fit`, `spr_hat`, and `f_hat`.

## Checks before you leave this example

- Render as it stands; expect overall convergence `ok` and SPR of order 0.3–0.6 for this fleet window.  
- Set `sel_fun <- "dsnormal"` and note whether SPR moves.  
- Set `n_years <- 5` and note whether the terminal SPR moves.  
- Only then point `ss3_dir` at another stock and set `rebuild <- TRUE`.
